{{Otheruses|Belt}}
A '''repulsor belt'''<ref name="PoG1">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref> or '''repulsorlift belt'''<ref name="Sepulchral">{{JournalCite|13|Day of the Sepulchral Night (short story)}}</ref> was a personal [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] generator. All non-gliding visitors to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Veron Minor|Veron]] were required to wear a repulsor belt when traversing the [[Gazar]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-[[City/Legends|cities]].<ref name="PoG1" /> The criminal [[Sevik (criminal)|Sevik]] used a repulsor belt to help him carry sacks of precious [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] from [[Zelosian's Chine]] to a waiting [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]].<ref name="Sepulchral" />
